text:
alisha (AE): Hey team — MapleBank POC asking for SOC 2 artifacts + pen-test letter. Need package by EOD Tuesday. Anyone able to assemble?

jordan (Security): I can grab the SOC 2 Type II and our current controls matrix. Do they need raw evidence (screenshots, configs) or just reports/attestations?

alisha (AE): They requested both the report + an assurance letter for a 3rd-party pen test. They mentioned legal will want a short pen-test attestation for procurement.

sam (Solutions Eng): For the POC we should also provide the architecture diagram showing VPC/private deployment for the dedicated option. I can sketch that and include the isolation details.

kevin (Compliance Ops): I can produce the pen-test attestation (template + signed) and package the SOC 2 report. Typical bundle we send: SOC2 Type II PDF, Syscomms attestation, penetration-test attestation (signed), evidence index (xlsx) with links to screenshots/logs, and infra diagram. Timeline: I can turn this around in ~24 hours if no extra evidence is requested.

alisha (AE): That would be perfect. Also, they asked about encryption at rest keys — is there a short artifact we can include that confirms KMS usage?

jordan (Security): Yes — include the crypto summary doc (one-pager) and snippet of the KMS policy. I'll export a small excerpt.

maria (Sales Eng): Pricing question: MapleBank is asking whether providing the Dedicated POC with reserved capacity affects the pricing for the first 3 months. Can someone confirm discount approach so I can set expectations?

sam (Solutions Eng): For short-term POCs we usually offer a pilot discount (10-20%) depending on committed baseline. I can draft the recommended number to present; need expected QPS/instances for the POC.

alisha (AE): I told them we'll circle back after we confirm the compliance bundle.

kevin (Compliance Ops): Ok prepping artifacts. Upload plan: I'll put a zipped bundle to the secure share and post the link. redwood-bot will create a ticket and provide the upload URL.

redwood-bot: Created ticket INF-5382 for MapleBank evidence package. Uploads: https://secure.redwood.internal/uploads/INF-5382 (expires in 7 days)

kevin (Compliance Ops): Drafted pen-test attestation, signed by our CISO. Added SOC2 Type II PDF and evidence index. Pushed to the upload link: `s3://redwood-compliance/INF-5382/maplebank-poc-bundle.zip`

jordan (Security): Quick note — the evidence index references two screenshots that contain internal hostnames. I redacted the hostnames and included sanitized versions.

alisha (AE): Amazing. I'll send the link to MapleBank procurement and copy legal. Any blocker for the POC to start if they sign SOW tomorrow?

sam (Solutions Eng): No blockers from infra side. We need the contact to approve the test credentials TTL (default 48h) — I'll include setup instructions.

maria (Sales Eng): I'll confirm pricing recommendation with finance then update the SOW.

alisha (AE): Thanks everyone — Kevin, Jordan: can you add the short KMS snippet and the infra diagram to the upload by EOD? I want to hand this off to MapleBank legal in the morning.

kevin (Compliance Ops): Will do, uploading the KMS one-pager now.

jordan (Security): Added the infra diagram (sanitized). All done from my side.

alisha (AE): Sending to MapleBank now.

maria (Sales Eng): FYI — procurement asked if we have a standard SLA appendix for Dedicated pilots. I have a template, can attach to SOW.

alisha (AE): Great — include it. Closing this thread once MapleBank confirms receipt. :thumbsup:
